findings.message: This PR gives the detail string a name -- `BACKFILL_NOT_FOUND` in `airflow.api_fastapi.core_api.security` -- and the routes now import it instead of restating it, but the new assertions here (and at 1543, 1619, 1663) hard-code the literal "Backfill not found" again. Import `BACKFILL_NOT_FOUND` and assert against it, so a reword of the detail cannot leave the tests asserting the old text.
